dbPath.label: Database Path
dbPath.help: SQLite file backing the graph store.

scope.label: Scope
scope.help: Where graph nodes are shared. 'workspace' shares across all agents in the workspace; 'agent' isolates per agent.

autoIngest.label: Auto Ingest
autoIngest.help: Extract facts, preferences, and open loops from transcript turns automatically.

tokenBudgetRatio.label: Token Budget Ratio
tokenBudgetRatio.help: Fraction of the turn token budget reserved for graph-injected context.

routing.label: Layer-5 Routing
routing.help: Gateway pre-inference router. 'off' keeps the configured primary model for every turn (default). 'shadow' runs the classifier and logs the verdict without enforcing it. 'on' overrides provider+model per the classifier verdict (trivial→google/gemini-2.5-flash, contextual→google/gemini-2.5-pro, complex→keep default). Do NOT use 'on' until your google provider inference path is verified working.

executionMode.label: Execution Mode
executionMode.help: Layer-7 critical-action gate on memory-graph's destructive tools (memory_set_persona, memory_forget, memory_consolidate, memory_ingest_claude_code). 'autonomous' (default) logs and lets them run. 'assisted' triggers OpenClaw's approval flow. 'suggest' blocks critical tools outright and asks the agent to describe the action instead.
